page.layout: One page of a chronological table in five columns of years, letters and feriae, with a column of Christian years at the far right. Running head at top centre, page number top right, column headings beneath it, gathering signature centred at the foot.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi

page.notes: The column of Christian years runs beside the rows; the feria column is the one with numbers 1 to 7 between the letters and the Dec. dates. The dash-marked Dec. dates stand beside the first row of each group of rows, between the Feriæ column and the Christi column. A small dot stands beside the row for 1751. A handwritten mark beside 1003 and a stray mark beside 1067 are not printed text and are omitted. The Indiction numerals are printed in old-style form and are copied as Arabic numerals. The page number is partly worn and is marked [?].
